mapper.select: /* RecipeMapper.retrieveRecipeInfo : 레시피 정보 상세 조회 */ SELECT R.RECIPE_SEQ , R.RECIPE_ID , R.RECIPE_TTL , R.DISH_NM , R.RECIPE_CN , R.COOKING_TIME , R.RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD , R.CATEGORY_CD , R.VIEW_CNT , U.USER_NM AS WRITER_NAME , R.REG_DT , R.RECIPE_STATUS , R.FILE_GRP_ID FROM RECIPE R INNER JOIN USERS U ON R.RGTR_KEY = U.USER_KEY AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
/* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeIngredientList : 레시피 재료 목록 조회 */ SELECT INGRD_NM , INGRD_AMT , INGRD_UNT FROM INGREDIENT WHERE RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
/* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeStepList : 레시피 단계 목록 조회 */ SELECT STEP_NO , STEP_CN , FILE_GRP_ID FROM RECIPE_STEP WHERE RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY STEP_NO
